def module(source,name):
    tree=ast.parse(source)
    tree.body=[n for n in tree.body if not(isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and
        any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='HERE' for t in n.targets))]
    value=types.ModuleType(name);value.__file__='/pure-control/'+name+'.py'
    value.HERE=PurePosixPath('/pure-control')
    exec(compile(tree,'<pure-module-'+name+'>','exec'),value.__dict__)
    return value

def one(nodes, kind, name=None):
    rows=[n for n in nodes if isinstance(n,kind) and (name is None or n.name==name)]
    assert len(rows)==1
    return rows[0]


def handler(module):
    worker=one(module.body,ast.FunctionDef,'worker')
    block=one([n for n in worker.body if isinstance(n,ast.Try) and n.finalbody],ast.Try)
    assert len(block.handlers)==1
    return block.handlers[0]


def execute_handler(module, seed, last, phase='inspect'):
    result=copy.deepcopy(seed)
    primary=RuntimeError('retained primary')
    calls=[]
    def remember(value,current,error):
        assert value is result and current=='original_phase' and error is primary
        calls.append(True)
    scope={'result':result,'phase':phase,'session':types.SimpleNamespace(sequence_observation=last),
           'u':types.SimpleNamespace(remember=remember),'current':'original_phase','error':primary}
    definitions=[copy.deepcopy(n) for n in module.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name==NAME]
    source=ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=definitions+copy.deepcopy(handler(module).body),type_ignores=[]))
    exec(compile(source,'<attribution-handler-only>','exec'),scope)
    assert calls==[True] and result.get('error')==seed.get('error')
    assert result.get('search_entry')==seed.get('search_entry')
    return result

def need(value,message):
    if not value:raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def read(path,maximum=1048576,expected=None,size=None):
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC)
    try:
        first=os.fstat(fd)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(first.st_mode) and first.st_nlink==1 and 0<=first.st_size<=maximum,
             'EXACT_BOUNDED_REGULAR_INPUT:'+str(path))
        value=bytearray()
        while len(value)<=maximum:
            part=os.read(fd,min(65536,maximum+1-len(value)))
            if not part:break
            value.extend(part)
        last=os.fstat(fd)
        fields=('st_dev','st_ino','st_mode','st_nlink','st_uid','st_gid','st_size','st_mtime_ns','st_ctime_ns')
        need(len(value)==first.st_size and all(getattr(first,k)==getattr(last,k) for k in fields),
             'FIXED_INPUT_CHANGED:'+str(path))
        value=bytes(value)
        need(expected is None or sha(value)==expected,'FIXED_INPUT_SHA:'+str(path))
        need(size is None or len(value)==size,'FIXED_INPUT_BYTES:'+str(path))
        return value
    finally:os.close(fd)


def load(path,digest,name,size=None):
    raw=read(path,expected=digest,size=size);m=types.ModuleType(name);m.__file__=str(path)
    exec(compile(raw,str(path),'exec'),m.__dict__)
    return m

def assessment_summary(q,step,sequence,plan):
    """No raw UI text, node list, screenshots or recommendations in the result."""
    result={}
    for phase,nonce in plan['nonces'].items():
        path=step/(nonce+'.assessment.json');raw=read(path);value=json.loads(raw);helper=value['helper']
        need(helper['nonce']==nonce and helper['self_uid']==HELPER_UID and
             helper['op']==('inspect' if phase=='inspect' else plan['operation'] if phase=='action' else 'state') and
             value['actual_command_returncode']==0 and value['actual_instrumentation_finish_code']==-1 and
             value['held_transport_returned_after_post_guard'] is True and helper['ok'] is True and
             helper['error'] is None and helper['secondary_errors']==[] and
             value['wire_sha256']==sha(q.qa.canonical(helper)), 'ACTUAL_CURRENT_ASSESSMENT_REQUIRED')
        row={'nonce':nonce,'operation':helper['op'],'assessment_bytes':len(raw),'assessment_sha256':sha(raw),
            'wire_sha256':value['wire_sha256'],'recorder_command_result_sha256':value['recorder_command_result_sha256'],
            'actual_command_returncode':0,'actual_instrumentation_finish_code':-1}
        if phase=='inspect':
            inspection=q.qa.inspect_record(helper['inspection'])
            need(value['wire_sha256']==sequence['inspection_wire_sha256'],'INSPECTION_WIRE_CHANGED')
            row.update(tree_sha256=inspection['tree_sha256'],window_sha256=inspection['window_sha256'],
                node_count=len(inspection['nodes']),window={k:inspection['window'][k] for k in ('package','display','type','focused')},
                window_observation=q.qa.window_observation(helper['window_observation']),
                connection_scoped_window_id=inspection['connection_scoped_window_id'],
                tree_observations=q.qa.tree_observations(helper['tree_observations'],'inspect',True),
                complete=True,raw_tree_private_only=True)
        elif phase=='action':
            need(helper['op']=='click' and helper['node_action_returned'] is True and
                 helper['node_action']=='ACTION_CLICK' and helper['inspection_nonce']==plan['nonces']['inspect'],
                 'ONE_ACTUAL_SOURCE_BOUND_SEARCH_ENTRY_ACTION')
            row.update(action_acknowledged=True,node_action='ACTION_CLICK',
                inspection_nonce=helper['inspection_nonce'],action_window=helper['action_window'])
        result[phase]=row
    return result


def retain_navigation_failure_observations(result):
    """Copy only the navigation's retained first-failure and independent post records."""
    navigation=result.get('search_entry')
    if type(navigation) is not dict:
        return
    if 'failed_sequence_observation' in navigation:
        result['failed_sequence_observation']=navigation['failed_sequence_observation']
    else:
        first=navigation.get('error')
        if type(first) is dict and first.get('phase')=='independent_post_entry_inspection' and \
                'failed_post_sequence_observation' in navigation:
            result['failed_sequence_observation']=navigation['failed_post_sequence_observation']
    if 'post_sequence' in navigation:
        result['independent_post_sequence_observation']=navigation['post_sequence']
    if 'failed_post_sequence_observation' in navigation:
        result['independent_failed_post_sequence_observation']=navigation['failed_post_sequence_observation']

def current_inspection(base,q,step,plan,sequence):
    need(sequence['installed_before']==sequence['installed_after']==q.installed,
         'EXACT_ACTUAL_INSTALLED_HELPER_DURING_READ')

def stable_entry(base,q,session,step,spec,result):
    previous=None;consecutive=0;first_matching_at=None;first_matching_index=None
    began=time.monotonic();deadline=began+STABLE_READ_BUDGET_SECONDS
    result['stability_reads']=[]
    for index,plan in enumerate(spec['stability']):
        need(time.monotonic()<deadline,'SEARCH_ENTRY_STABILITY_READ_DEADLINE')
        sequence=session.sequence(copy.deepcopy(plan))
        inspection,summary=current_inspection(base,q,step,plan,sequence)
        scope=sequence['foreground_before']
        need(sequence['restoration_qualified'] is True and sequence['after_state_completed'] is True and
             scope==sequence['foreground_after'] and scope['activity']==ENTRY_ACTIVITY,
             'EXACT_CURRENT_SEARCH_ENTRY_ACTIVITY')
        # Eligibility is established for each complete observation only.
        # The unchanged action Session selects from its own fresh complete tree.
        q.qa.select_unique_clickable(inspection,SELECTOR)
        identity={'scope':scope,'tree_sha256':inspection['tree_sha256'],
                  'window_sha256':inspection['window_sha256']}
        observed_at=time.monotonic()
        need(observed_at<deadline,'SEARCH_ENTRY_STABILITY_READ_DEADLINE')
        if previous!=identity:
            consecutive=1;first_matching_at=observed_at;first_matching_index=index
        else:
            consecutive+=1
        span=observed_at-first_matching_at
        result['stability_reads'].append({'index':index,'sequence':sequence,'assessments':summary,
            'public_entry_unique_and_eligible':True,'authorizes_future_node_action':False,
            'observed_elapsed_seconds':observed_at-began,'matching_samples':consecutive,
            'matching_span_seconds':span})
        previous=identity
        if consecutive>=STABLE_READ_MINIMUM and span>=STABLE_READ_SPAN_SECONDS:
            result['stable_read_indices']=list(range(first_matching_index,index+1))
            result['stability_window']={'qualified':True,'sample_count':consecutive,
                'observed_span_seconds':span,'minimum_samples':STABLE_READ_MINIMUM,
                'minimum_span_seconds':STABLE_READ_SPAN_SECONDS,
                'maximum_samples':STABLE_READ_MAXIMUM,'budget_seconds':STABLE_READ_BUDGET_SECONDS,
                'absence_of_changes_between_samples_or_afterward_claimed':False,
                'action_still_requires_original_full_tree_window_and_refresh_guards':True}

    """Constrain the exact selection point of the unchanged Session.sequence."""
    def __init__(self,qa,session):self.original,self.session=qa,session
    def __getattr__(self,name):return getattr(self.original,name)
    def select_unique_clickable(self,inspection,selector):
        observed=self.session.sequence_observation
        need(selector==SELECTOR and observed['foreground_before']['activity']==ENTRY_ACTIVITY and
             observed['foreground_before']['package']==PACKAGE and
             inspection['window']['package']==PACKAGE,
             'ACTION_BOUND_CURRENT_SEARCH_ENTRY_SCOPE_REQUIRED')
        return self.original.select_unique_clickable(inspection,selector)

        'click_acknowledged':False,'post_inspection_attempted':False,'post_inspection_completed':False,
        'business_success_verified':False,'query_entered':False,'search_results_verified':False,
        'whole_app_production_ready':False,'raw_UI_tree_private_only':True}

        nonlocal primary
        row={'phase':phase,'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error)}
        if primary is None:primary=error;out['error']=row
        else:out['secondary_errors'].append(row);primary.add_note(phase+': '+repr(error))
    try:
        stable_entry(base,q,session,step,spec,out)

        # unchanged Session reads a new complete tree then invokes this selector.
        original=session.qa

        try:

        finally:

        sequence=out['entry_sequence']
        need(sequence['click_acknowledged'] is True and sequence['restoration_qualified'] is True and
             sequence['after_state_completed'] is True and
             sequence['installed_before']==sequence['installed_after']==q.installed,
             'EXACT_ENTRY_CLICK_AND_RESTORATION_REQUIRED')
        out['entry_assessments']=base.assessment_summary(q,step,sequence,spec['entry'])
        out['click_acknowledged']=True
    except BaseException as error:
        if hasattr(session,'sequence_observation'):
            out['failed_sequence_observation']=copy.deepcopy(session.sequence_observation)
        remember('stable_search_entry_or_click',error)
    finally:
        # A failed read/action is never replayed. One independently named final
        # read is still attempted, with its own original after-state finally.
        out['post_inspection_attempted']=True

            sequence=session.sequence(copy.deepcopy(spec['post']))
            _,summary=current_inspection(base,q,step,spec['post'],sequence)
            need(sequence['restoration_qualified'] is True and sequence['after_state_completed'] is True and

            out['post_sequence']=sequence;out['post_assessments']=summary

    result['inspection_completed']=True;result['search_entry_click_completed']=True

        row={'nonce':nonce,'operation':helper['op'],'assessment_bytes':len(raw),'assessment_sha256':sha(raw),

def retain_navigation_failure_observations(result):
    """Copy only the navigation's retained first-failure and independent post records."""
    navigation=result.get('search_entry')
    if type(navigation) is not dict:
        return
    if 'failed_sequence_observation' in navigation:
        result['failed_sequence_observation']=navigation['failed_sequence_observation']
    else:
        first=navigation.get('error')
        if type(first) is dict and first.get('phase')=='independent_post_entry_inspection' and \
                'failed_post_sequence_observation' in navigation:
            result['failed_sequence_observation']=navigation['failed_post_sequence_observation']
    if 'post_sequence' in navigation:
        result['independent_post_sequence_observation']=navigation['post_sequence']
    if 'failed_post_sequence_observation' in navigation:
        result['independent_failed_post_sequence_observation']=navigation['failed_post_sequence_observation']

"},"sources":{"adapter":""""New owned helper on the frozen recorder's held Main transport.

Default is PLAN_ONLY. Execution requires an externally pinned completed build,
an already installed byte-identical owned APK, a separately initialized fresh
recorder flow, an explicit once-only plan, and interactive-production admission.
This file does not install, launch, close tasks, enter numeric PID namespaces,
or call the old v2 helper. Original task ownership and Main guards are retained.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import sys
import types

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RECORDER_MANIFEST_SHA = '002ee581a4bb399536dd7d594d01f050e2540d9c049b0cfb37e1c96954b6caff'
SELF = 'org.droidloom.qa.amazon.r4'
BUILD_COMMANDS = ['idle-gate-javac','idle-gate-java','javac','d8','aapt-package','align','create-owned-signing-key','sign',
                  'signature','alignment','badging','permissions','manifest']


def require(value, reason):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(reason)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def bounded(path, maximum=1048576):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_CLOEXEC | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        first = os.fstat(fd)
        require(stat.S_ISREG(first.st_mode) and first.st_nlink == 1 and
                0 <= first.st_size <= maximum, 'BOUNDED_SINGLE_REGULAR_FILE_REQUIRED')
        chunks = []; count = 0
        while True:
            part = os.read(fd, min(65536, maximum + 1 - count))
            if not part:
                break
            chunks.append(part); count += len(part)
            require(count <= maximum, 'FILE_GREW_PAST_BOUND')
        last = os.fstat(fd)
        fields = ('st_dev','st_ino','st_mode','st_nlink','st_uid','st_gid','st_size','st_mtime_ns','st_ctime_ns')
        require(count == first.st_size and all(getattr(first,k) == getattr(last,k) for k in fields),
                'FILE_CHANGED_DURING_READ')
        return b''.join(chunks)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def pinned(path, expected, maximum=1048576):
    require(isinstance(expected, str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', expected), 'EXTERNAL_SHA_REQUIRED')
    raw = bounded(path, maximum)
    require(sha(raw) == expected, 'PINNED_FILE_CHANGED: '+str(path))
    return raw


def load(path, expected, name):
    raw = pinned(path, expected)
    module = types.ModuleType(name); module.__file__ = str(path)
    exec(compile(raw, str(path), 'exec'), module.__dict__)
    return module


def own_source(expected):
    manifest = json.loads(pinned(HERE/'SOURCE_PINS.json', expected, 131072))
    require(isinstance(manifest.get('files'), dict) and 4 <= len(manifest['files']) <= 32,
            'EXACT_OWNED_SOURCE_SET_REQUIRED')
    for name, row in manifest['files'].items():
        rel = Path(name)
        require(not rel.is_absolute() and '..' not in rel.parts and str(rel) == name,
                'SOURCE_RELATIVE_PATH_REQUIRED')
        require(len(pinned(HERE/name, row['sha256'])) == row['bytes'], 'SOURCE_SIZE_CHANGED')
    require({'qa_adapter.py','qa_contract.py','build_candidate.py','AndroidManifest.xml',
             'src/org/droidloom/qa/amazon/r4/ActionRunner.java',
             'src/org/droidloom/qa/amazon/r4/InspectionIdleGate.java',
             'tests/InspectionIdleGateChecks.java','check_idle_contract.py'} <= set(manifest['files']),
            'OWNED_SOURCE_CLOSURE_INCOMPLETE')
    return manifest


def validate_plan(plan, qa):
    require(isinstance(plan, dict) and plan.get('schema') == 1 and
            plan.get('operation') in ('state','inspect','click','set_text'), 'OWNED_PLAN_REQUIRED')
    op = plan['operation']; keys = {'schema','operation','nonces'}
    if op in ('click','set_text'):
        keys.add('selector')
        selector = plan.get('selector')
        require(isinstance(selector, dict) and selector and
                set(selector) <= {'resource_id','text','content_desc','class'} and
                all(isinstance(v, str) and 0 < len(v.encode('utf-8')) <= 256 for v in selector.values()),
                'EXACT_NODE_SELECTOR_REQUIRED')
    if op == 'set_text':
        keys.add('value')
        require(plan.get('value') == qa.PUBLIC_SEARCH_QUERY and
                {'resource_id','class'}<=set(plan['selector']) and plan['selector']['class']=='android.widget.EditText' and
                re.fullmatch(r'com\.amazon\.mShop\.android\.shopping:id/[A-Za-z0-9_]+',plan['selector']['resource_id']),
                'ONLY_OBSERVED_EXACT_EDIT_RESOURCE_AND_PUBLIC_QUERY')
    require(set(plan) == keys and isinstance(plan['nonces'], dict), 'EXACT_PLAN_KEYS_REQUIRED')
    names = {'state'} if op == 'state' else {'before','inspect','after'} | ({'action'} if op in ('click','set_text') else set())
    require(set(plan['nonces']) == names, 'EXACT_PHASE_NONCES_REQUIRED')
    values = [qa.nonce(value) for value in plan['nonces'].values()]
    require(len(set(values)) == len(values), 'DISTINCT_PHASE_NONCES_REQUIRED')
    return plan


def qualified_build(args, manifest, builder):
    raw = pinned(args.build_receipt, args.build_receipt_sha256)
    receipt = json.loads(raw)
    require(receipt.get('state') == 'BUILT_STATIC_VERIFIED_ANDROID_UNRUN' and
            receipt.get('package') == SELF and receipt.get('source_manifest_sha256') == args.source_manifest_sha256,
            'MATCHING_COMPLETED_OWNED_BUILD_REQUIRED')
    require(receipt.get('source_sha256') == {key: row['sha256'] for key, row in manifest['files'].items()} and
            receipt.get('source_unchanged') is True and receipt.get('tools_unchanged') is True and
            receipt.get('manifest_contract') == builder.manifest_contract(), 'BUILD_SOURCE_OR_MANIFEST_DIFFERS')
    require(receipt.get('tools_before') == receipt.get('tools_after') and
            set(receipt['tools_before']) == set(builder.TOOLS), 'BUILD_TOOL_SET_DIFFERS')
    for name, (path, digest) in builder.TOOLS.items():
        value = receipt['tools_before'][name]
        require(value['sha256'] == digest and value['declared_path'] == path and
                type(value['bytes']) is int and value['bytes'] > 0, 'BUILD_TOOL_PIN_DIFFERS')
    require(receipt.get('error') is None and receipt.get('android_installed') is False and
            receipt.get('Main_mutations') == receipt.get('Android_UI_actions') == 0, 'BUILD_SCOPE_CHANGED')
    commands = receipt.get('commands')
    require(isinstance(commands, list) and [row.get('name') for row in commands] == BUILD_COMMANDS and
            all(row.get('returncode') == 0 and row.get('owned_child_joined') is True and
                row.get('error') is None and row.get('secondary_errors') == [] for row in commands),
            'ACTUAL_BUILD_COMMAND_COMPLETION_REQUIRED')
    require(receipt.get('compiled_python_sources')=={name:row['sha256'] for name,row in manifest['files'].items()
            if name.endswith('.py')},'ALL_PINNED_PYTHON_SOURCES_MUST_COMPILE')
    idle_gate=receipt.get('inspection_idle_gate_controls')
    idle_protocol=receipt.get('inspection_idle_protocol_controls')
    require(isinstance(idle_gate,dict) and set(idle_gate)=={
                'report','stdout_sha256','gate_source_sha256','control_source_sha256'} and
            isinstance(idle_protocol,dict) and set(idle_protocol)=={'report','control_source_sha256'},
            'ACTUAL_IDLE_CONTROL_REPORTS_REQUIRED')
    builder.validate_idle_controls(idle_gate['report'],builder.IDLE_GATE_CASES)
    builder.validate_idle_controls(idle_protocol['report'],builder.IDLE_PROTOCOL_CASES,
                                   manifest['files']['qa_contract.py']['sha256'])
    require(idle_gate['stdout_sha256']==commands[1]['stdout_sha256'] and
            idle_gate['gate_source_sha256']==manifest['files']['src/org/droidloom/qa/amazon/r4/InspectionIdleGate.java']['sha256'] and
            idle_gate['control_source_sha256']==manifest['files']['tests/InspectionIdleGateChecks.java']['sha256'] and
            idle_protocol['control_source_sha256']==manifest['files']['check_idle_contract.py']['sha256'],
            'ACTUAL_IDLE_CONTROLS_SOURCE_OR_COMMAND_BINDING_CHANGED')
    artifact = receipt.get('APK')
    require(isinstance(artifact, dict) and artifact.get('sha256') == args.apk_sha256 and
            type(artifact.get('bytes')) is int and 0 < artifact['bytes'] <= 2097152 and
            receipt.get('signer_certificate_sha256') == args.signer_certificate_sha256,
            'EXTERNALLY_REVIEWED_APK_AND_SIGNER_REQUIRED')
    require(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', args.apk_sha256) and
            re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', args.signer_certificate_sha256), 'EXPLICIT_APK_SIGNER_SHA_REQUIRED')
    return {'build_receipt_sha256':sha(raw), 'source_manifest_sha256':args.source_manifest_sha256,
            'APK':artifact, 'signer_certificate_sha256':args.signer_certificate_sha256,
            'self_instrumentation':True, 'old_v2_provenance_inherited':False}


class Session:
    def __init__(self, flow, recorder, qa, proof, helper_uid):
        require(flow.contract.sha256 == RECORDER_MANIFEST_SHA and not flow._private_backend_transport,
                'FROZEN_PUBLIC_RECORDER_TRANSPORT_REQUIRED')
        require(flow.scope.get('schema') == 'pocket4-current-recorder-scope-v2' and
                flow.scope.get('current_baseline_schema') == qa.MAIN_BASELINE_SCHEMA and
                flow.scope.get('epoch_sha256') == qa.MAIN_EPOCH and
                flow.scope.get('current_baseline_sha256') == qa.MAIN_BASELINE_SHA and
                flow.scope.get('current_baseline_qualification_sha256') == qa.MAIN_BASELINE_QUALIFICATION_SHA and
                flow.scope.get('package') == qa.PACKAGE and type(flow.scope.get('uid')) is int and
                flow.scope['uid'] == qa.UID,
                'TYPED_CURRENT_HOST_SCOPE_AND_HELPER_BINDING_REQUIRED')
        require(type(helper_uid) is int and 10000 <= helper_uid < 100000 and helper_uid not in (10129,10117,10125,10164,10165,10166,10169,10170,10175,10154),
                'EXACT_NEW_OWNED_HELPER_UID_REQUIRED')
        self.flow, self.recorder, self.qa, self.proof, self.uid = flow, recorder, qa, proof, helper_uid
        self.nonces = set()

    def installed(self):
        f = self.flow; f.guard(); binding = f.bind()
        actual = f.android(['/system/bin/cmd','package','list','packages','-U','--user','0',SELF], 8)
        require(actual.decode('utf-8','strict').splitlines() == ['package:'+SELF+' uid:'+str(self.uid)],
                'OWNED_HELPER_UID_READBACK_DIFFERS')
        raw = f.android(['/system/bin/cmd','package','path','--user','0',SELF], 8)
        lines = raw.decode('utf-8','strict').splitlines()
        require(len(lines) == 1 and lines[0].startswith('package:/data/app/') and lines[0].endswith('/base.apk'),
                'SINGLE_OWNED_BASE_APK_REQUIRED')
        path = lines[0][8:]
        require(len(path) <= 1024 and '\0' not in path and '..' not in Path(path).parts and str(Path(path)) == path,
                'OWNED_APK_PATH_INVALID')
        data, metadata = binding.target.read_file(path, 2097152)
        require(len(data) == self.proof['APK']['bytes'] and sha(data) == self.proof['APK']['sha256'],
                'INSTALLED_APK_NOT_MATCHING_VERIFIED_SOURCE_AND_SIGNER')
        del data
        f.guard()
        return {'package':SELF, 'uid':self.uid, 'base_apk':path, 'apk_sha256':self.proof['APK']['sha256'],
                'bytes':self.proof['APK']['bytes'], 'held_file':metadata,
                'signer_bound_by_exact_signed_apk_bytes':self.proof['signer_certificate_sha256']}

    def instrument(self, request):
        qa, f = self.qa, self.flow
        qa.validate_request(request)
        require(request['nonce'] not in self.nonces, 'NONCE_CANNOT_BE_REPLAYED')
        self.nonces.add(request['nonce'])
        self.recorder.write_new(f.step/(request['nonce']+'.request.json'), request)
        before = f.command_index
        out = f.android(qa.instrumentation_argv(request), 20, mutation=request['op'] in ('click','set_text'))
        require(f.command_index == before+1, 'ONE_ACTUAL_HELD_COMMAND_REQUIRED')
        stem = f.step/('command-%03d' % f.command_index)
        raw = bounded(str(stem)+'.result.json', 65536); row = json.loads(raw)
        stderr = bounded(str(stem)+'.stderr', 1048576)
        require(row.get('owned_command_joined') is True and row.get('spawned') is True and
                row.get('timed_out') is False and row.get('errors') == [] and
                row.get('stdout_sha256') == sha(out) and row.get('stderr_sha256') == sha(stderr),
                'ACTUAL_JOINED_COMMAND_OBSERVATION_REQUIRED')
        # f.android has already recorded lease exit and the mandatory post guard.
        try:
            assessed = qa.parse_completed(out, stderr, row['returncode'], request, self.uid)
        except BaseException as primary:
            # Keep the strict finish gate and original exception. A helper's
            # explicit finish(0) can additionally explain the failure without
            # exporting an inspection tree or manufacturing a success result.
            failure = {'request_nonce':request['nonce'],'operation':request['op'],
                'qualified_success':False,'command_result_sha256':sha(raw),
                'stdout_sha256':sha(out),'stderr_sha256':sha(stderr),
                'primary_error':{'type':type(primary).__name__,'message':str(primary)}}
            try:
                failure['helper_rejection'] = qa.failure_diagnostic(out,request,self.uid)
            except Exception as diagnostic_error:
                failure['diagnostic_unavailable'] = type(diagnostic_error).__name__
            primary.details = {'previous_details':getattr(primary,'details',None),
                               'owned_helper_failure':failure}
            try:
                self.recorder.write_new(f.step/(request['nonce']+'.failed-assessment.json'),failure)
            except BaseException as secondary:
                primary.add_note('failed assessment write: '+type(secondary).__name__)
            raise
        assessed['recorder_command_result_sha256'] = sha(raw)
        assessed['held_transport_returned_after_post_guard'] = True
        self.recorder.write_new(f.step/(request['nonce']+'.assessment.json'), assessed)
        return assessed

class Flow:
    """Amazon-only object satisfying the actual original Session interface."""
    def __init__(self,*,recorder,contract,target,environment,transport,main_guard,root,step,
                 phase,scope,activation,tasks,qa,inspect_plan,resolve,read,deadline):
        current_task_scope(scope,qa,contract)
        need(scope['epoch_sha256']==transport.FRAMEWORK_EPOCH_SHA256,'EXACT_CURRENT_TRANSPORT_EPOCH_REQUIRED')
        need(root.is_dir() and step.is_relative_to(root),'NEW_PRIVATE_FLOW_REQUIRED')
        self.recorder,self.contract,self.target=recorder,contract,target
        self.main_guard,self.root,self.step=main_guard,root,step
        self.phase,self.scope,self.activation,self.tasks=phase,scope,activation,tasks
        self.current_qualified_scope=dict(scope);self.qa=qa
        self.deadline=deadline;self.command_index=0;self.action_attempted=False
        self._private_backend_transport=False;self._android_mutation=False
        self.binding=types.SimpleNamespace(target=target)
        self.artifacts=None;self.closed=False;self.poisoned=False;self.launch_claimed=False
        self.policy=Policy(phase,qa,resolve,inspect_plan,step,read,self.selected_task)

        def record(kind,value):
            recorder.write_new(step/('transport-%03d.%s.json'%(value['sequence'],kind)),value)
        def runner(argv,**options):
            need(options['close_fds'] is True and options['stdout']==subprocess.PIPE and
                 options['stderr']==subprocess.PIPE,'EXACT_HELD_RUNNER_PROTOCOL_REQUIRED')
            if self._private_backend_transport:
                # Same privacy branch as the frozen recorder: foreground text
                # is parsed in memory; its transport hash/rc remains recorded.
                return subprocess.run(argv,**options)
            return recorder.Flow.command(self,argv,options['timeout'],mutation=self._android_mutation,
                label='Android command',pass_fds=options['pass_fds'],check=False,host_env=options['env'])
        self.transport=transport.BoundArun(target=target,environment=environment,guard=lambda action_attempted:self.guard(attempted=action_attempted),
            record=record,epoch_sha256=transport.FRAMEWORK_EPOCH_SHA256,
            init_pid=activation['framework_epoch']['binding']['processes']['init']['host_pid'],
            package=PACKAGE,uid=UID,interactive_production=True,runner=runner)

    def guard(self,attempted=False):
        current_task_scope(self.scope,self.qa,self.contract)
        need(self.scope==self.current_qualified_scope,'CURRENT_AMAZON_TASK_SCOPE_CHANGED')
        need(not self.closed and time.monotonic()<self.deadline,'OPEN_BOUNDED_AMAZON_FLOW_REQUIRED')
        self.main_guard();self.target.verify()
        if self.artifacts is not None:self.artifacts.verify_held()

    def bind(self):
        self.guard();return self.binding

    def android(self,argv,timeout=20,*,mutation=False):
        try:
            need(not self.poisoned and not self.closed,'POISONED_AMAZON_COMMAND_NOT_REPLAYABLE')
            self.policy.admit(argv,timeout,mutation,self._private_backend_transport)
            self._android_mutation=mutation
            return self.transport(argv,timeout)
        except BaseException:
            self.poisoned=True
            raise
        finally:
            self._android_mutation=False

    def command(self,argv,timeout,*,mutation=False,label=None):
        expected=['/usr/bin/sudo','-n','-u','#1000','--','/usr/bin/env',
            'XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000','DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus',
            '/usr/bin/droidloomctl','launch',PACKAGE,'--component',self.scope['component'],'--json']
        need(self.phase=='launch' and argv==expected and timeout==70 and mutation is True and
             label=='One native launch' and not self.launch_claimed and not self.poisoned,
             'ONLY_ONE_EXACT_ORIGINAL_NATIVE_LAUNCH')
        self.launch_claimed=True
        try:return self.recorder.Flow.command(self,argv,timeout,mutation=True,label=label)
        except BaseException:
            self.poisoned=True
            raise

    def stacks(self,timeout=20):
        value=self.recorder.Flow.stacks(self,timeout)
        self.last_stack_task_ids=sorted(value[2])
        return value

    def selected_task(self):
        value=self.recorder.Flow.selected_task(self)
        need(set(value)=={'task','package','epoch_sha256','prelaunch_absent','cleanup_allowed',
             'launch_step','prelaunch_task_ids','native_receipt_sha256'} and
             value['package']==PACKAGE and value['prelaunch_absent'] is True and
             value['cleanup_allowed'] is True and value['launch_step']=='launch-01' and
             type(value['task']) is int and value['task']>0 and
             isinstance(value['prelaunch_task_ids'],list) and
             all(type(x) is int and x>=0 for x in value['prelaunch_task_ids']) and
             value['task'] not in value['prelaunch_task_ids'] and
             isinstance(value['native_receipt_sha256'],str) and
             len(value['native_receipt_sha256'])==64 and
             set(value['native_receipt_sha256'])<=set('0123456789abcdef'),
             'NEW_AMAZON_TASK_PROOF_REQUIRED')
        return value

    def launch_locked(self):
        need(self.phase=='launch','LAUNCH_PHASE_REQUIRED')
        return self.recorder.Flow.launch_locked(self)

    def cleanup(self):
        need(self.phase=='cleanup','CLEANUP_PHASE_REQUIRED')
        return self.recorder.Flow.cleanup(self)

    def close(self):
        self.closed=True
        self.target.close()


def open_task_context(ref,util,context,source_manifest,source_verify,flow_root,step,
                      transport,result,deadline,phase,qa,inspect_plan,resolve,expected_scope, *,
                      install_source_manifest):
    """Same held Main/classpath primitives as the qualified Amazon install.

    The only newly constructed object is the phase-restricted task Flow above.
    No original Bili Flow/MainBinding or old UI client constructor is called.
    """
    source=util.module(context.INSTALLED_SHARED/'source_contract.py',context.CONTRACT_SHA,
                       'amazon_task_shared_contract')
    contract=source.SourceContract(context.INSTALLED_SHARED/'source-manifest.json',context.SHARED_MANIFEST)
    recorder=contract.load('recorder.py','amazon_task_actual_command')
    held=contract.load('references/held_runtime_r5.py','amazon_task_actual_held_main')
    binding=contract.load('main_binding.py','amazon_task_shared_classpath_only')
    activation=ref.current_baseline()
    own_scope=context.baseline_scope(ref,activation)
    epoch=ref.module(ref.read(ref.EPOCH_SOURCE,expected=ref.EPOCH_SOURCE_SHA),ref.EPOCH_SOURCE,
                     'amazon_task_fixed_epoch')
    scope_raw=util.read(flow_root/'scope.json',65536)
    scope=json.loads(scope_raw)
    current_task_scope(scope,qa,contract)
    need(scope==expected_scope and all(scope[key]==value for key,value in own_scope.items()),
         'EXACT_NEW_CURRENT_AMAZON_FLOW_SCOPE_REQUIRED')
    need(util.read(flow_root/'baseline.json',expected=ref.BASELINE_SHA)==ref.read(ref.BASELINE,expected=ref.BASELINE_SHA)
         and util.read(flow_root/'baseline-qualification.json',expected=ref.QUALIFICATION_SHA)==ref.read(ref.QUALIFICATION,expected=ref.QUALIFICATION_SHA),
         'SAVED_TYPED_CURRENT_BASELINE_CHANGED')
    info=flow_root.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid==0 and not info.st_mode&0o077,
         'PRIVATE_ROOT_OWNED_NEW_FLOW_REQUIRED')
    target=None
    def guard():
        need(time.monotonic()<deadline,'AMAZON_PHASE_DEADLINE')
        source_verify(source_manifest);contract.verify()
        need(util.read(flow_root/'scope.json',65536)==scope_raw,'AMAZON_SCOPE_CHANGED')
        ref.read(recorder.APP,expected=recorder.APP_SHA)
        util.read(source.HELPER_PATH,source.HELPER_BYTES,source.HELPER_SHA,source.HELPER_BYTES)
        observation=ref.main_guard(activation,epoch)
        if target is not None:context.verify_target_data(target,activation,binding)
        return observation
    result['Main_before']=guard();result['shared_helper']=source.verify_shared_helper()
    expected=activation['framework_epoch']['binding']['processes']['init']
    proc=os.open('/proc/'+str(expected['host_pid']),os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC)
    try:actual=held.proc_identity_at(proc,expected['host_pid'],time.monotonic()+3)
    finally:os.close(proc)
    need(binding.same_epoch_identity(actual,expected),'FIXED_MAIN_INIT_IDENTITY_CHANGED')
    try:
        target=held.HeldTarget(actual,source.HELPER_PATH,source.HELPER_SHA);guard()
        app=util.module(Path(recorder.APP),recorder.APP_SHA,'amazon_task_discovery_only')
        init,discovered,status=context.current_discovery(
            util,install_source_manifest,util.verify_source,util.HERE,
            app,activation,epoch,guard)
        need(init==expected['host_pid'] and status['host_pid']==activation['status']['host_pid'],
             'FIXED_MAIN_DISCOVERY_CHANGED')
        values,classpath=binding.main_classpaths(held,target,activation['framework_epoch'],epoch,guard)
        need(all(discovered.get(k)==v for k,v in values.items()),'CLASSPATH_DISCOVERY_CHANGED')
        environment=transport.environment_values(discovered)
        tasks=recorder.task_functions(context.INSTALLED_SHARED/'references/task_scope_baseline.py')
        flow=Flow(recorder=recorder,contract=contract,target=target,environment=environment,
            transport=transport,main_guard=guard,root=flow_root,step=step,phase=phase,
            scope=scope,activation=activation,tasks=tasks,qa=qa,inspect_plan=inspect_plan,
            resolve=resolve,read=util.read,deadline=deadline)
        ref.write_new(step/'held-main-binding.json',{'target':target.record,'classpath':classpath,
            'shared_helper':result['shared_helper'],'target_package':PACKAGE,'target_uid':UID,
            'shared_recorder_primitive_manifest':context.SHARED_MANIFEST,
            'amazon_task_runtime_source_manifest':source_manifest,'Bili_Flow_instantiated':False})
        return flow,recorder,lambda:ref.main_guard(activation,epoch)
    except BaseException as primary:
        if target is not None:
            try:target.close()
            except BaseException as secondary:primary.add_note('held target close: '+repr(secondary))
        raise
","contract":""""Strict owned-helper wire contract and offline assessor. No process/Android API."""
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import re
import zlib

PROTOCOL = 'pocket4-owned-amazon-qa-v4'
SELF = 'org.droidloom.qa.amazon.r4'
COMPONENT = SELF + '/' + SELF + '.ActionRunner'
PACKAGE = 'com.amazon.mShop.android.shopping'
UID = 10129
MAIN_EPOCH = '7d927812392d30ab8cca43da87c0785e24695ca724da93b3b465122502b8045c'
MAIN_BASELINE_SCHEMA = 'pocket4-main-current-baseline-v2'
MAIN_BASELINE_SHA = '633912ff4595ce898c4c0e0f9ac06c1f422203d90fbd2e583192f35ff7a04364'
MAIN_BASELINE_QUALIFICATION_SHA = 'ae8d54ee64fe23676d7f68f8092c0915d3f0f41662d8b7d4be86b85201071a6e'
MAX_REQUEST = 16384
MAX_RESULT = 524288
MAX_COMPRESSED_WIRE = 262144
MAX_STDOUT = 4 * ((MAX_COMPRESSED_WIRE + 2) // 3) + 4096
MAX_NODES = 512
MAX_DEPTH = 32
PUBLIC_SEARCH_QUERY = "usb c cable"
SCOPE_KEYS = {'package', 'uid', 'user', 'display', 'activity', 'window_token', 'main_epoch_sha256', 'main_baseline_schema', 'main_baseline_sha256', 'main_baseline_qualification_sha256'}


class ProtocolError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def require(value, code):
    if not value:
        raise ProtocolError(code)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def _json_types(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        require(all(isinstance(k, str) for k in value), 'JSON_KEYS_NOT_STRINGS')
        for item in value.values():
            _json_types(item)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for item in value:
            _json_types(item)
    else:
        require(value is None or type(value) in (str, int, bool), 'JSON_FLOAT_OR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE')
        if type(value) is int:
            require(-(1 << 63) <= value < (1 << 63), 'INTEGER_RANGE')


def canonical(value):
    _json_types(value)
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode('ascii')


def nonce(value):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}', value), 'EXACT_NONCE_REQUIRED')
    return value


def digest(value):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value), 'EXACT_DIGEST_REQUIRED')
    return value


def scope(value):
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == SCOPE_KEYS, 'EXACT_SCOPE_KEYS_REQUIRED')
    require(value['package'] == PACKAGE and type(value['uid']) is int and value['uid'] == UID and
            type(value['user']) is int and value['user'] == 0 and type(value['display']) is int and
            value['display'] == 0 and value['main_epoch_sha256'] == MAIN_EPOCH and
            value['main_baseline_schema'] == MAIN_BASELINE_SCHEMA and
            value['main_baseline_sha256'] == MAIN_BASELINE_SHA and
            value['main_baseline_qualification_sha256'] == MAIN_BASELINE_QUALIFICATION_SHA,
            'FIXED_MAIN_AMAZON_SCOPE_REQUIRED')
    require(isinstance(value['activity'], str) and len(value['activity']) <= 256 and
            re.fullmatch(r'com\.amazon\.mShop\.android\.shopping/[A-Za-z0-9_.$]+', value['activity']), 'HOST_ACTIVITY_REQUIRED')
    require(isinstance(value['window_token'], str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{1,32}', value['window_token']),
            'HOST_WINDOW_TOKEN_REQUIRED')
    return value


def validate_request(value):
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('protocol') == PROTOCOL, 'PROTOCOL_REQUIRED')
    nonce(value.get('nonce'))
    op = value.get('op')
    expected = {'protocol', 'nonce', 'op'}
    if op in ('inspect', 'click', 'set_text'):
        expected.add('scope')
        scope(value.get('scope'))
    if op in ('click','set_text'):
        expected.update(('inspection_nonce', 'inspection_sha256', 'node_path', 'node_sha256'))
        require(nonce(value.get('inspection_nonce')) != value['nonce'], 'DISTINCT_ACTION_NONCE_REQUIRED')
        digest(value.get('inspection_sha256')); digest(value.get('node_sha256'))
        require(isinstance(value.get('node_path'), str) and
                re.fullmatch(r'0(?:/[0-9]{1,2}){0,32}', value['node_path']), 'NODE_PATH_REQUIRED')
    if op == 'set_text':
        expected.update(('node_resource_id','value'))
        require(value.get('value') == PUBLIC_SEARCH_QUERY,'ONLY_FIXED_PUBLIC_SEARCH_QUERY_ALLOWED')
        require(isinstance(value.get('node_resource_id'),str) and
                re.fullmatch(r'com\.amazon\.mShop\.android\.shopping:id/[A-Za-z0-9_]+',value['node_resource_id']) and
                len(value['node_resource_id']) <= 256,'EXACT_EDIT_RESOURCE_REQUIRED')
    require(op in ('state', 'inspect', 'click', 'set_text') and set(value) == expected, 'EXACT_OPERATION_KEYS_REQUIRED')
    raw = canonical(value)
    require(0 < len(raw) <= MAX_REQUEST, 'REQUEST_BOUND')
    return raw


def instrumentation_argv(request):
    raw = validate_request(request)
    return ['/system/bin/am', 'instrument', '-w', '-r', '-e', 'request',
            base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii'), COMPONENT]


def state(value):
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {'accessibility_enabled', 'touch_exploration_enabled',
            'enabled_service_count', 'enabled_services_sha256'}, 'STATE_FIELDS_REQUIRED')
    require(type(value['accessibility_enabled']) is bool and type(value['touch_exploration_enabled']) is bool,
            'ACTUAL_STATE_BOOLEAN_REQUIRED')
    require(type(value['enabled_service_count']) is int and 0 <= value['enabled_service_count'] <= 64,
            'SERVICE_COUNT_BOUND')
    digest(value['enabled_services_sha256'])
    return value



def decode_wire(encoded):
    require(isinstance(encoded,str) and 0<len(encoded)<=4*((MAX_COMPRESSED_WIRE+2)//3),
            'COMPRESSED_BASE64_BOUND')
    try:
        compressed=base64.b64decode(encoded,validate=True)
    except (ValueError,base64.binascii.Error) as error:
        raise ProtocolError('INVALID_COMPRESSED_BASE64') from error
    require(0<len(compressed)<=MAX_COMPRESSED_WIRE and
            base64.b64encode(compressed).decode('ascii')==encoded,'CANONICAL_COMPRESSED_BASE64_REQUIRED')
    decoder=zlib.decompressobj(31)
    try:
        raw=decoder.decompress(compressed,MAX_RESULT+1)
    except zlib.error as error:
        raise ProtocolError('INVALID_GZIP_WIRE') from error
    require(0<len(raw)<=MAX_RESULT and decoder.eof and not decoder.unconsumed_tail and
            not decoder.unused_data,'SINGLE_BOUNDED_COMPLETE_GZIP_MEMBER_REQUIRED')
    return raw


def parse_completed(stdout, stderr, returncode, request, helper_uid):
    """Call only after the held command is joined and its post-guard is recorded.

    This verifies a successful wire result; the caller must retain any original
    command failure before invoking it. No failing finish code is treated as PASS.
    """
    raw_request = validate_request(request)
    require(type(returncode) is int and returncode == 0, 'ACTUAL_COMMAND_FAILED')
    require(isinstance(stdout, bytes) and isinstance(stderr, bytes) and len(stdout) <= MAX_STDOUT,
            'COMMAND_OUTPUT_BOUND')
    require(stderr == b'', 'COMMAND_STDERR_REQUIRES_REVIEW')
    text = stdout.decode('utf-8', 'strict')
    require('INSTRUMENTATION_FAILED' not in text and 'INSTRUMENTATION_ABORTED' not in text,
            'FRAMEWORK_INSTRUMENTATION_FAILED')
    encoded = re.findall(r'^INSTRUMENTATION_RESULT: owned_qa_result_gzip_base64=([^\r\n]*)\r?$', text, re.M)
    finishes = re.findall(r'^INSTRUMENTATION_CODE: (-?[0-9]+)\r?$', text, re.M)
    require(len(encoded) == 1 and finishes == ['-1'], 'EXACT_SUCCESSFUL_FINISH_REQUIRED')
    raw = decode_wire(encoded[0])
    require(0 < len(raw) <= MAX_RESULT, 'RESULT_BOUND')
    value = json.loads(raw)
    require(canonical(value) == raw and isinstance(value, dict), 'CANONICAL_RESULT_REQUIRED')
    require(value.get('protocol') == PROTOCOL and value.get('nonce') == request['nonce'] and
            value.get('op') == request['op'] and value.get('request_sha256') == sha(raw_request) and
            value.get('wire_codec') == 'gzip-canonical-json-v1',
            'RESULT_REQUEST_BINDING_FAILED')
    require(type(helper_uid) is int and 10000 <= helper_uid < 100000 and helper_uid not in (UID, 10117, 10125, 10164, 10165, 10166, 10169, 10170, 10175, 10154) and value.get('self_uid') == helper_uid and
            type(value.get('self_pid')) is int and value['self_pid'] > 1, 'INSTALLED_HELPER_IDENTITY_REQUIRED')
    require(value.get('ok') is True and value.get('error') is None and value.get('secondary_errors') == [] and
            value.get('claim_persistence_completed') is True and value.get('helper_work_completed') is True,
            'HELPER_DID_NOT_COMPLETE_SUCCESSFULLY')
    require(value.get('automatic_retry') is False and value.get('business_success_verified') is False and
            value.get('accessibility_mode_restoration_verified') is None,
            'UNSUPPORTED_SUCCESS_OR_RESTORATION_CLAIM')
    require(type(value.get('started_elapsed_ms')) is int and type(value.get('finished_elapsed_ms')) is int and
            0 <= value['finished_elapsed_ms'] - value['started_elapsed_ms'] <= 12000, 'HELPER_ELAPSED_BOUND')
    restore = value.get('restoration')
    require(isinstance(restore, dict) and restore.get('service_info_verified') is True, 'OWN_SERVICE_RESTORE_FAILED')
    observed_idle=inspection_idle_observation(value.get('inspection_idle_observation'),request['op'],
                                               value['started_elapsed_ms'],success_required=True)
    if observed_idle:
        require(observed_idle['last_elapsed_ms']<=value['finished_elapsed_ms'],
                'INSPECTION_IDLE_OUTLIVES_HELPER_RESULT')
    if request['op'] == 'state':
        require(value.get('action_attempted') is False and value.get('outcome_unknown') is False and
                value.get('ui_automation_connected') is False and value.get('requires_post_termination_state_check') is False and
                restore.get('service_info_captured') is False, 'STATE_PROBE_MUST_NOT_CONNECT_AUTOMATION')
        state(value.get('state'))
        require(value.get('window_observation') == {} and value.get('tree_observations') == [],'STATE_CANNOT_ENUMERATE_WINDOWS_OR_TREES')
    else:
        require(value.get('host_scope_attestation') == request['scope'] and value.get('activity_verified_inside_helper') is False and
                value.get('target_uid_verified') == UID, 'HOST_SCOPE_ECHO_OR_ACTUAL_UID_CHANGED')
        require(value.get('requires_post_termination_state_check') is True and restore.get('service_info_captured') is True and
                restore.get('connection_flags') == 1, 'NON_SUPPRESSING_CONNECTION_REQUIRED')
        for field in ('service_flags_before', 'service_flags_during', 'service_flags_after',
                      'service_capabilities_before', 'service_capabilities_after'):
            require(type(restore.get(field)) is int, 'ACTUAL_SERVICE_READBACK_REQUIRED')
        require(restore['service_flags_before'] == restore['service_flags_after'] and
                restore['service_capabilities_before'] == restore['service_capabilities_after'] and
                restore['service_flags_during'] == (restore['service_flags_before'] | 16 | 64) and
                all(restore[k] & 4 == 0 for k in ('service_flags_before', 'service_flags_during', 'service_flags_after')),
                'SERVICE_READBACK_OR_TOUCH_EXPLORATION_MISMATCH')
        state(value.get('accessibility_state_before_connection'))
        observed_window = window_observation(value.get('window_observation'))
        observed_trees = tree_observations(value.get('tree_observations'),request['op'],complete_required=True)
        if request['op'] == 'inspect':
            require(value.get('action_attempted') is False and value.get('outcome_unknown') is False, 'INSPECTION_CANNOT_ACT')
            inspect_record(value.get('inspection'))
            require(observed_trees[0]['began_elapsed_ms']>=observed_idle['last_elapsed_ms'],
                    'INSPECTION_CAPTURE_MUST_FOLLOW_ITS_IDLE_OBSERVATION')
            require(observed_window['selected_window_id'] == value['inspection']['connection_scoped_window_id'],
                    'INSPECTION_WINDOW_NOT_SELECTED_CENSUS_WINDOW')
            require(observed_trees[0]['emitted_nodes'] == len(value['inspection']['nodes']) and
                    observed_trees[0]['serialized_bytes'] == len(canonical(value['inspection'])),
                    'COMPLETE_TREE_COUNTERS_MUST_MATCH_ACTUAL_INSPECTION')
        else:
            require(value.get('action_attempted') is True and value.get('outcome_unknown') is True and
                    value.get('node_action') == ('ACTION_SET_TEXT' if request['op']=='set_text' else 'ACTION_CLICK') and
                    value.get('node_action_returned') is True,
                    'CLICK_DISPATCH_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED')
            for source_key, result_key in (('inspection_nonce','inspection_nonce'), ('inspection_sha256','inspection_sha256'),
                                           ('node_path','target_node_path'), ('node_sha256','target_node_sha256')):
                require(value.get(result_key) == request[source_key], 'CLICK_TARGET_BINDING_FAILED')
            require(observed_window['selected_window_id'] == value.get('connection_scoped_window_id'),
                    'ACTION_WINDOW_NOT_SELECTED_CENSUS_WINDOW')
            if request['op']=='set_text':
                require(value.get('target_resource_id') == request['node_resource_id'] and
                        value.get('requested_value_sha256') == value.get('observed_value_sha256') == sha(PUBLIC_SEARCH_QUERY.encode()) and
                        value.get('value_readback_verified') is True,'ACTUAL_PUBLIC_QUERY_READBACK_REQUIRED')
    return {'helper': value, 'wire_sha256': sha(raw), 'stdout_sha256': sha(stdout), 'stderr_sha256': sha(stderr),
            'actual_command_returncode': returncode, 'actual_instrumentation_finish_code': -1,
            'command_join_and_epoch_guards_must_be_bound_separately': True}


def inspection_idle_observation(value, operation, started, success_required):
    """Safe event-quiet metadata only; neither complete-tree nor future-action qualification."""
    require(isinstance(value,dict) and len(canonical(value))<=4096,'SAFE_INSPECTION_IDLE_BOUND')
    if operation!='inspect':
        require(value=={},'ONLY_INSPECT_MAY_WAIT_FOR_EVENT_IDLE')
        return value
    if value=={}:

            value['call_count'] in (0,1),'INSPECTION_IDLE_TIME_OR_CALL_BOUND')
    expected=min(2000,max(0,started+8000-began)) if began>=started and started<=(1<<63)-1-8000 else 0
    require(value['global_timeout_ms']==expected,'INSPECTION_IDLE_REMAINING_BUDGET_MISMATCH')
    for name in ('exception_class','secondary_clock_exception_class'):
        item=value[name]
        require(isinstance(item,str) and len(item)<=192 and (item=='' or
                re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*(?:\.[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)*',item)),
                'INSPECTION_IDLE_EXCEPTION_CLASS_BOUND')
    allowed={'','INSPECTION_IDLE_CLOCK_FAILED','INSPECTION_IDLE_CLOCK_INVALID',
             'INSPECTION_IDLE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED','INSPECTION_IDLE_TIMEOUT',

                value['gate_error'] in ('INSPECTION_IDLE_CLOCK_FAILED','INSPECTION_IDLE_CLOCK_INVALID',
                                       'INSPECTION_IDLE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED'),

        require(value['qualified'] is True and value['call_count']==1 and value['api_returned'] is True and
                value['gate_error']==value['exception_class']==value['secondary_clock_exception_class']=='' and
                began>=started and 0<=value['waited_ms']<=value['global_timeout_ms'] and last<=started+8000,
                'SUCCESSFUL_BOUNDED_EVENT_IDLE_REQUIRED')
    else:
        require(value['gate_error']!='','INSPECTION_IDLE_FAILURE_CANNOT_BE_EMPTY')
    return value

def inspect_record(value):
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('complete') is True and
            value.get('traversal') == 'visible-non-password-subtrees', 'COMPLETE_INSPECTION_REQUIRED')
    window = value.get('window')
    require(isinstance(window, dict) and window.get('package') == PACKAGE and window.get('display') == 0 and
            window.get('type') == 1 and window.get('focused') is True, 'FOCUSED_BILI_WINDOW_REQUIRED')
    require(value.get('window_sha256') == sha(canonical(window)), 'WINDOW_HASH_FAILED')
    require(type(value.get('observed_elapsed_ms')) is int and value['observed_elapsed_ms'] >= 0 and
            type(value.get('connection_scoped_window_id')) is int and value['connection_scoped_window_id'] >= 0,
            'ACTUAL_WINDOW_AND_OBSERVATION_TIME_REQUIRED')
    nodes = value.get('nodes')
    require(isinstance(nodes, list) and 0 < len(nodes) <= MAX_NODES and value.get('tree_sha256') == sha(canonical(nodes)),
            'COMPLETE_TREE_HASH_FAILED')
    seen = set()
    for node in nodes:
        require(isinstance(node, dict) and node.get('package') == PACKAGE and isinstance(node.get('path'), str) and
                re.fullmatch(r'0(?:/[0-9]{1,2}){0,32}', node['path']) and node['path'] not in seen, 'NODE_SCOPE_OR_PATH_FAILED')
        seen.add(node['path'])
        require(node.get('node_sha256') == sha(canonical({k:v for k,v in node.items() if k != 'node_sha256'})), 'NODE_HASH_FAILED')
        require(type(node.get('editable')) is bool and type(node.get('supports_set_text')) is bool,
                'ACTUAL_NODE_EDIT_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED')
        if node.get('password') is True or node.get('visible') is False:
            require(node.get('content_redacted') is True and not ({'text','text_sha256','content_desc','content_desc_sha256'} & set(node)),
                    'PASSWORD_OR_INVISIBLE_CONTENT_MUST_NOT_BE_READ')
    return value


def failure_diagnostic(stdout, request, helper_uid):
    """Bound failure metadata only. This never returns a qualified assessment."""
    validate_request(request)
    require(isinstance(stdout,bytes) and len(stdout) <= MAX_STDOUT,'FAILURE_OUTPUT_BOUND')
    text = stdout.decode('utf-8','strict')
    encoded = re.findall(r'^INSTRUMENTATION_RESULT: owned_qa_result_gzip_base64=([^\r\n]+)\r?$',text,re.M)
    finishes = re.findall(r'^INSTRUMENTATION_CODE: (-?[0-9]+)\r?$',text,re.M)
    require(len(encoded) == 1 and finishes == ['0'],'EXACT_FAILURE_FINISH_REQUIRED')
    raw = decode_wire(encoded[0])
    require(0 < len(raw) <= MAX_RESULT,'FAILURE_WIRE_BOUND')
    value = json.loads(raw)
    require(canonical(value) == raw and value.get('protocol') == PROTOCOL and
            value.get('nonce') == request['nonce'] and value.get('op') == request['op'] and
            value.get('request_sha256') == sha(canonical(request)) and value.get('self_uid') == helper_uid and
            value.get('wire_codec') == 'gzip-canonical-json-v1',
            'FAILURE_REQUEST_IDENTITY_BINDING')
    require(value.get('ok') is False and isinstance(value.get('error'),str) and
            re.fullmatch('[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,95}',value['error']),'ACTUAL_HELPER_REJECTION_REQUIRED')
    # Never include inspection nodes, titles, event text or recommendations.
    result = {key:value.get(key) for key in ('nonce','op','self_uid','self_pid','error',
        'claim_persistence_completed','helper_work_completed','action_attempted','outcome_unknown',
        'started_elapsed_ms','finished_elapsed_ms','requires_post_termination_state_check','restoration')}
    result.update(wire_sha256=sha(raw),instrumentation_finish_code=0,qualified_success=False)
    if 'tree_observations' in value:
        result['tree_observations'] = tree_observations(value['tree_observations'],request['op'],complete_required=False)
    if 'window_observation' in value:
        result['window_observation'] = window_observation(value['window_observation'],ready_required=False)
    if 'inspection_idle_observation' in value:
        result['inspection_idle_observation']=inspection_idle_observation(
            value['inspection_idle_observation'],request['op'],value.get('started_elapsed_ms'),success_required=False)
    return result



def tree_observations(value, operation, complete_required):
    require(isinstance(value,list) and len(value)<=3 and len(canonical(value))<=8192,
            'SAFE_TREE_COUNTER_BOUND')
    if operation=='state':
        require(value==[],'STATE_CANNOT_ENUMERATE_TREES')
        return value
    expected=['inspection'] if operation=='inspect' else ['action_target','action_final_window']
    require(len(value)<=len(expected),'TREE_CAPTURE_COUNT_BOUND')
    if complete_required:require(len(value)==len(expected),'COMPLETE_TREE_CAPTURE_SEQUENCE_REQUIRED')
    keys={'capture','purpose','node_limit','depth_limit','child_limit','json_byte_limit','attempted_nodes',
          'emitted_nodes','max_attempted_depth','max_observed_children','serialized_bytes','complete',
          'began_elapsed_ms','last_elapsed_ms'}
    for index,row in enumerate(value):
        require(isinstance(row,dict) and set(row)==keys and row['capture']==index+1 and
                row['purpose']==expected[index] and type(row['complete']) is bool and
                all(type(row[k]) is int for k in keys-{'purpose','complete'}),'EXACT_SAFE_TREE_COUNTERS_REQUIRED')
        require((row['node_limit'],row['depth_limit'],row['child_limit'],row['json_byte_limit'])==
                (MAX_NODES,MAX_DEPTH,64,MAX_RESULT-65536),'EXACT_TREE_LIMITS_REQUIRED')
        require(0<=row['attempted_nodes']<=MAX_NODES+1 and 0<=row['emitted_nodes']<=MAX_NODES and
                0<=row['max_attempted_depth']<=MAX_DEPTH+1 and 0<=row['max_observed_children']<(1<<31) and
                0<=row['serialized_bytes']<=33554432 and
                0<=row['began_elapsed_ms']<=row['last_elapsed_ms'],'TREE_COUNTER_VALUE_BOUND')
        if complete_required:require(row['complete'],'PARTIAL_TREE_CANNOT_QUALIFY')
        if row['complete']:
            require(0<row['emitted_nodes']==row['attempted_nodes']<=MAX_NODES and
                    row['max_attempted_depth']<=MAX_DEPTH and row['max_observed_children']<=64 and
                    0<row['serialized_bytes']<=MAX_RESULT-65536,'COMPLETE_TREE_COUNTERS_INCONSISTENT')
    return value


def window_observation(value, ready_required=True):
    require(isinstance(value,dict) and len(canonical(value)) <= 32768,'WINDOW_OBSERVATION_BOUND')
    if not value and not ready_required:
        return value
    require(set(value) <= {'requested_display','selection','wait_budget_ms','ready','first','last',
                          'samples','waited_ms','selected_display','selected_window_id',
                          'recheck_max_ms','sample_timings','cache_api','cache_policy',
                          'cache_runtime_sdk','cache_attempts','cache_clears','cache_last_result','cache_last_exception'} and
            value.get('requested_display') == 0 and value.get('wait_budget_ms') == 2000 and
            value.get('recheck_max_ms') == 100 and
            value.get('selection') == 'exact-display-0-focused-application' and
            type(value.get('ready')) is bool,'EXACT_WINDOW_OBSERVATION_SCOPE')
    timings = value.get('sample_timings')
    require(isinstance(timings,list) and len(timings) <= 64,'BOUNDED_WINDOW_SAMPLE_TIMINGS_REQUIRED')
    attempts, clears = value.get('cache_attempts'), value.get('cache_clears')
    samples = value.get('samples',0)
    require({'cache_api','cache_policy','cache_runtime_sdk','cache_attempts','cache_clears',
             'cache_last_result','cache_last_exception'} <= set(value) and
            value.get('cache_api') == 'android.app.UiAutomation.clearCache()' and
            value.get('cache_policy') == 'require_public_own_connection_clear_before_each_query' and
            type(value.get('cache_runtime_sdk')) is int and value['cache_runtime_sdk'] >= 0 and
            type(samples) is int and type(attempts) is int and type(clears) is int and
            0 <= samples <= clears <= attempts <= min(samples+1,64) and
            (value.get('cache_last_result') is None or type(value['cache_last_result']) is bool) and
            (value.get('cache_last_exception') is None or
             (isinstance(value['cache_last_exception'],str) and
              re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$.]{0,255}',value['cache_last_exception']))),
            'EXACT_PUBLIC_OWN_CACHE_CLEAR_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED')
    previous_elapsed = previous_serial = -1
    for index, row in enumerate(timings,1):
        require(isinstance(row,dict) and set(row) == {'sample','event_serial','elapsed_ms','cache_cleared'} and
                type(row['sample']) is int and row['sample'] == index and
                type(row['event_serial']) is int and row['event_serial'] >= 0 and
                type(row['elapsed_ms']) is int and row['elapsed_ms'] >= 0 and
                row['event_serial'] >= previous_serial and row['elapsed_ms'] >= previous_elapsed and
                row['cache_cleared'] is True,
                'ORDERED_METADATA_ONLY_WINDOW_SAMPLE_TIMINGS_REQUIRED')
        previous_elapsed, previous_serial = row['elapsed_ms'], row['event_serial']
    require(('samples' not in value and not timings) or value.get('samples') == len(timings),
            'WINDOW_SAMPLE_COUNT_MISMATCH')
    if ready_required:
        require(attempts == clears == samples and value.get('cache_last_result') is True and
                value.get('cache_last_exception') is None and value['cache_runtime_sdk'] >= 34,
                'EVERY_WINDOW_QUERY_NEEDS_CONFIRMED_CACHE_CLEAR')
        require(value['ready'] is True and value.get('selected_display') == 0 and
                type(value.get('selected_window_id')) is int and
                type(value.get('samples')) is int and 1 <= value['samples'] <= 64 and
                type(value.get('waited_ms')) is int and 0 <= value['waited_ms'] <= 2000 and
                timings and timings[-1]['elapsed_ms'] <= value['waited_ms'],
                'ACTUAL_DISPLAY_ZERO_WINDOW_READINESS_REQUIRED')
    for name in ('first','last'):
        if name not in value:
            require(not ready_required,'COMPLETE_WINDOW_CENSUS_REQUIRED')
            continue
        row = value[name]
        require(isinstance(row,dict) and set(row) == {'sample','event_serial','elapsed_ms','displays','windows'} and
                type(row['sample']) is int and 1 <= row['sample'] <= 64 and
                type(row['event_serial']) is int and row['event_serial'] >= 0 and
                type(row['elapsed_ms']) is int and row['elapsed_ms'] >= 0 and
                isinstance(row['displays'],list) and len(row['displays']) <= 8 and
                all(type(d) is int and d >= 0 for d in row['displays']) and
                isinstance(row['windows'],list) and len(row['windows']) <= 128,'WINDOW_CENSUS_SHAPE')
        for window in row['windows']:
            require(isinstance(window,dict) and set(window) == {'display','id','type','focused','active','accessibility_focused','layer'} and
                    all(type(window[k]) is int for k in ('display','id','type','layer')) and
                    window['display'] in row['displays'] and
                    all(type(window[k]) is bool for k in ('focused','active','accessibility_focused')),
                    'METADATA_ONLY_WINDOW_CENSUS_REQUIRED')
        require(timings and all(row[key] == timings[0 if name == 'first' else -1][key]
                for key in ('sample','event_serial','elapsed_ms')), 'WINDOW_CENSUS_TIMING_MISMATCH')
    if ready_required:
        require(value['first']['sample'] == 1 and value['last']['sample'] == value['samples'] and
                sum(window['display'] == 0 and window['type'] == 1 and window['focused'] is True
                    for window in value['last']['windows']) == 1,'UNIQUE_DISPLAY_ZERO_FOCUSED_WINDOW_REQUIRED')
        require(sum(window['display'] == 0 and window['id'] == value['selected_window_id'] and
                    window['type'] == 1 and window['focused'] is True for window in value['last']['windows']) == 1,
                'SELECTED_WINDOW_MUST_MATCH_ACTUAL_LAST_CENSUS')
    return value


def select_unique_clickable(inspection, selector):
    inspect_record(inspection)
    require(isinstance(selector, dict) and selector and set(selector) <= {'resource_id','text','content_desc','class'},
            'EXACT_BOUNDED_NODE_SELECTOR_REQUIRED')
    require(all(isinstance(v, str) and 0 < len(v.encode('utf-8')) <= 256 for v in selector.values()), 'SELECTOR_BOUND')
    found = [node for node in inspection['nodes'] if node.get('password') is False and
             node.get('enabled') is True and node.get('visible') is True and node.get('clickable') is True and
             all(node.get(k) == v and node.get(k + '_truncated') is False for k, v in selector.items())]
    require(len(found) == 1, 'NODE_SELECTOR_NOT_UNIQUE_AND_ELIGIBLE')
    return {'node_path': found[0]['path'], 'node_sha256': found[0]['node_sha256']}



def select_unique_editable(inspection, selector):

            set(selector)<={'resource_id','class','text','content_desc'} and

            all(isinstance(v,str) and 0<len(v.encode('utf-8'))<=256 for v in selector.values()),
            'EXACT_OBSERVED_EDIT_RESOURCE_AND_CLASS_REQUIRED')
    found=[node for node in inspection['nodes'] if node.get('password') is False and
           node.get('enabled') is True and node.get('visible') is True and node.get('editable') is True and
           node.get('supports_set_text') is True and
           all(node.get(k)==v and node.get(k+'_truncated') is False for k,v in selector.items())]
    require(len(found)==1,'EDIT_SELECTOR_NOT_UNIQUE_AND_ELIGIBLE')
    return {'node_path':found[0]['path'],'node_sha256':found[0]['node_sha256'],
            'node_resource_id':found[0]['resource_id']}


def assess_restoration(before, operation, after):
    """These inputs must be parse_completed returns from three joined commands."""
    first, middle, last = before['helper'], operation['helper'], after['helper']
    require(first['op'] == last['op'] == 'state' and middle['op'] in ('inspect','click','set_text'), 'STATE_OPERATION_STATE_SEQUENCE_REQUIRED')

    require(first['self_uid'] == middle['self_uid'] == last['self_uid'], 'HELPER_UID_CHANGED')
    require(first['state'] == middle['accessibility_state_before_connection'] == last['state'] and
            middle['restoration']['service_info_verified'] is True,
            'POST_TERMINATION_ACCESSIBILITY_STATE_CHANGED')
    return {'accessibility_mode_restoration_verified': True,
            'basis': 'actual own-service readback plus independent no-automation state command after successful instrumentation termination',
            'state_before': first['state'], 'state_after': last['state'],
            'wire_sha256': [before['wire_sha256'], operation['wire_sha256'], after['wire_sha256']],
            'business_success_verified': False, 'whole_app_production_ready': False}

def read(path,maximum=1048576,expected=None,size=None):
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC)
    try:
        first=os.fstat(fd)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(first.st_mode) and first.st_nlink==1 and 0<=first.st_size<=maximum,
             'EXACT_BOUNDED_REGULAR_INPUT:'+str(path))
        value=bytearray()
        while len(value)<=maximum:
            part=os.read(fd,min(65536,maximum+1-len(value)))
            if not part:break
            value.extend(part)
        last=os.fstat(fd)
        fields=('st_dev','st_ino','st_mode','st_nlink','st_uid','st_gid','st_size','st_mtime_ns','st_ctime_ns')
        need(len(value)==first.st_size and all(getattr(first,k)==getattr(last,k) for k in fields),
             'FIXED_INPUT_CHANGED:'+str(path))
        value=bytes(value)
        need(expected is None or sha(value)==expected,'FIXED_INPUT_SHA:'+str(path))
        need(size is None or len(value)==size,'FIXED_INPUT_BYTES:'+str(path))
        return value
    finally:os.close(fd)

def retain_navigation_failure_observations(result):
    """Copy only the navigation's retained first-failure and independent post records."""
    navigation=result.get('search_entry')
    if type(navigation) is not dict:
        return
    if 'failed_sequence_observation' in navigation:
        result['failed_sequence_observation']=navigation['failed_sequence_observation']
    else:
        first=navigation.get('error')
        if type(first) is dict and first.get('phase')=='independent_post_entry_inspection' and \
                'failed_post_sequence_observation' in navigation:
            result['failed_sequence_observation']=navigation['failed_post_sequence_observation']
    if 'post_sequence' in navigation:
        result['independent_post_sequence_observation']=navigation['post_sequence']
    if 'failed_post_sequence_observation' in navigation:
        result['independent_failed_post_sequence_observation']=navigation['failed_post_sequence_observation']
